Orange Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 11:35pm

Ingredients




4 juice oranges, unpeeled and sliced
1 teaspoon minced garlic
1 teaspoon Chinese spices
2 cups soy sauce
1 tablespoon lemon juice
8 pieces halved boneless chicken breast, skin removed

Preparation

1 Mix and let set 1 hour. Pour over cut up chicken and let set for 2 hours.  2 Bake chicken in sauce at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minute or until chicken tender.
